(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is configured to detect at least a difference in displacement between the first battery cell and the enclosure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material, and wherein the force sensing material is selected from the group consisting of a quantum tunneling composite, a polymer membrane binary switch, and a pressure sensitive ink. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a pressure sensitive ink, configured to detect pressure variations related to at least one force influencing the first battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises at least one of a polymer membrane binary switch and a discrete dome switch, and is configured to detect at least one force influencing the first battery cell.
